_about: The owner's file (the release gate's hook refuses an agent's edits to it). ceilings: the most open entries the older audits may hold (python tools/gap_audit.py: gap-audit entries; data/doc_gaps_baseline.json: sentence-level gaps); lower them as the items are built, never raise them without a reason written in `why`. waived: items of data/completeness.json the owner lets a release go out without, each with `id`, `why` and `date`.
